# cb:b051 · dag-structural-types

> DAG node type field accepts exactly four values - attestation, aggregation, inference, prescription - one per epistemic operation (attest, aggregate, infer, prescribe) - and determines which other fields are meaningful

**Type:** prescription (contract-grade) · **Kind:** state-machine · **Domain:** system · **Status:** active
**Tags:** `dag-schema`, `type-system`
**Created:** 2026-06-10

## Invariants

- Every active node has exactly one type
- type is a closed enum: attestation | aggregation | inference | prescription
- Only prescriptions can carry rules or invariants
- Structural type determines valid operations (only prescriptions are materialized)

## Rules

```json
{
  "given": "A node is being written to the DAG",
  "scenario": "Structural type validation",
  "then": "The type must be one of: attestation, aggregation, inference, prescription",
  "when": "The type field is validated"
}
{
  "given": "A node has type: attestation",
  "scenario": "Attestation carries an artifact",
  "then": "The node must have a non-null artifact field",
  "when": "The node is validated"
}
{
  "given": "A node has type: aggregation or type: inference",
  "scenario": "Aggregation and inference carry deps",
  "then": "The node must have a non-empty deps array",
  "when": "The node is validated"
}
{
  "given": "A node has rules or invariants populated",
  "scenario": "Only prescriptions carry contracts",
  "then": "The node must have type: prescription (descriptive types cannot carry contracts)",
  "when": "The node is validated"
}
```
